content.title: Product Environment Loop | Macro, Portal, Transparent Sphere Return
content.summary: Establish one original product through macro material anchors before showing the complete object. Connect at least two visible ingredient or design details to one coherent environment identity. Use one functional product action as the sole optical transition into the environment. Expand the environment, then enclose its recognizable geometry inside one transparent carrier. Return the carrier and environment to the same complete product with stable shape, label-free identity and hero proof.

quick_start.input_format: Establish one original product through macro material anchors before showing the complete object. + Connect at least two visible ingredient or design details to one coherent environment identity. + Use one functional product action as the sole optical transition into the environment. + Expand the environment, then enclose its recognizable geometry inside one transparent carrier. + Return the carrier and environment to the same complete product with stable shape, label-free identity and hero proof.
quick_start.recommended_input: Begin inside one bevel of an original label-free square mineral desk lamp: macro clear quartz, a brushed brass ring and a pale blue internal lens; pull back to reveal the complete lamp on a stone ledge. A clearly adult hand turns the same lamp switch once; the pale blue lens emits one controlled refractive flare that becomes an optical passage into the canyon, with no magical object replacement. The globe contracts into the lamp's pale blue lens. Return to the same complete square lamp on the ledge, preserving quartz bevel, brass ring and proportions; hold with no brand or text.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one original product through macro material anchors before showing the complete object. The reusable mechanism is the ordered baseline, trigger, continuity, controlled escalation and terminal proof—not the source identities, brands, wording, locations, props, exact styling, choreography, camera path, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish one original product through macro material anchors before showing the complete object.
invariants.purpose: Makes the baseline measurable before the mechanism changes it.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without the baseline, later change has no trustworthy reference state.

invariants.rule: Connect at least two visible ingredient or design details to one coherent environment identity.
invariants.purpose: Binds the first visible change to a specific cause rather than decoration.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without a visible trigger, the transition reads as an arbitrary edit.

invariants.rule: Use one functional product action as the sole optical transition into the environment.
invariants.purpose: Preserves identity, material or spatial continuity through the middle transition.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without continuity, the sequence becomes unrelated montage or identity drift.

invariants.rule: Expand the environment, then enclose its recognizable geometry inside one transparent carrier.
invariants.purpose: Raises intensity or information while retaining the same readable grammar.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without controlled escalation, the middle either plateaus or turns into noise.

invariants.rule: Return the carrier and environment to the same complete product with stable shape, label-free identity and hero proof.
invariants.purpose: Provides a terminal proof that resolves the mechanism instead of merely stopping.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without terminal proof, the promised result or reversal remains unverified.
